disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to permit an inspection or hindering/interfering with inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To refuse to permit an inspection provided for by the Oklahoma Apiary Act, or to hinder or interfere with, in any way, the inspection or the person authorized to make the inspection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Renting a colony of bees and misrepresenting the strength of the colony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To rent a colony of bees to another and misrepresent the strength of a colony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay any fee, fine, or penalty as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To fail to pay any fee, fine, or penalty as required and established by the Oklahoma Apiary Act or promulgated rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Retaining Africanized honeybees except for approved research purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To retain Africanized honeybees except for approved research purposes pursuant to this act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly exposing hive equipment to material from a diseased colony or bee pest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To knowingly expose comb, honey, frames, empty hives, cover, bottom boards or tools, or other appliances to any material from a diseased colony or apiary or infested with a bee pest

disciplinary_grounds.quote: To fail to comply with any State Board of Agriculture order

disciplinary_grounds.quote: To violate any provision of the Oklahoma Apiary Act and the rules promulgated by the Board

definition_quote.value: Beekeeper means a person who owns, possesses, controls, or manages one or more colonies of bees for any purpose
definition_quote.quote: "Beekeeper" means a person who owns, possesses, controls, or manages one or more colonies of bees for any purpose

registration_required.quote: The Oklahoma Department of Agriculture, Food, and Forestry, on a form prescribed by the Department, shall establish a voluntary registration program.

apiary_identification_required.quote: Any person owning an apiary that does not register with the Department shall be required to post personal contact information at or near their apiary.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: If no beekeeper or owner is identified for the apiary, then it may be designated as an abandoned apiary, and the Department may destroy the apiary or donate it to an appropriate research facility.

import_permit_required.quote: Issue entry permits to any person transporting bees or apiary equipment into this state

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: Any apiary, apiary equipment, bee, or hive shipped or transported interstate shall be accompanied with a certificate of inspection issued by the state of origin.

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: It shall be illegal to retain Africanized honeybees except for specifically approved research purposes as determined by rules promulgated by the State Board of Agriculture.

regulated_diseases.quote: "Pest" means any living organism which is responsible, directly or indirectly, for any condition that is or may be harmful or detrimental to bees in any of their four life stages, or interferes with their management including, but not limited to, diseases, parasites, and Africanized honeybees

quarantine_authority.quote: Upon the discovery of any bee disease or pest, a premise shall be quarantined by the Oklahoma Department of Agriculture, Food, and Forestry.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: The State Board of Agriculture or its authorized agents shall have the authority to enter any premises or mode of transportation during reasonable hours for the purpose of implementing the Oklahoma Apiary Act

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: A person shall not sell or offer for sale any apiary, apiary equipment, bee, or hive in this state unless free of bee diseases or pests.

apiary_minimum_distance_rule.quote: No person shall locate a new apiary within close proximity to an established apiary if the Department determines that the new apiary presents an imminent danger of spreading bee diseases or pests or interferes with the proper feeding and foraging of an established apiary.

voluntary_beekeeper_education_program.quote: The State Board of Agriculture may promulgate rules to establish a Certified Beekeeper Program.
